mentions.name: Native TUI app library
mentions.description: This is a native library for building terminal user interface (TUI) applications without the large runtime bloat of Node, Bun, or Go.
mentions.problem: Node, Bun, and Go bring 20-60MB of bloat when building TUI apps.
